# Golden Pagoda — Project Instructions

Discord bot ("**Oda Helper**") that OCRs Warframe profile screenshots, verifies platform + clan, and assigns roles. The maintainer agent for this repo is **Oda Assistant** (see `.github/agents/oda-assistant.agent.md`).

## Stack

- **Runtime**: Python 3.12, `discord.py` 2.x. OCR via a local **Ollama** vision model (`OLLAMA_OCR_MODEL`) with OCR.space (engine 3) then Tesseract as fallbacks (`ocr_engine.py`).
- **Entrypoint**: `bot.py` (Discord client + slash commands + V2 component helpers + verify/role flow). Card rendering (the profile PNG, all Pillow/numpy) lives in `cards.py`; pure OCR-parse + mastery-format helpers in `logic.py`. Analytics + titles + onboarding state in `analytics.py` (stdlib `sqlite3`, fail-soft). The member-records ("profile-log") channel is the **source of truth** for member profile data — there is no durable profile cache. `records_index.py` keeps a tiny `user_id → [record message_ids]` JSON index. `bot.py` re-exports the `cards.py` symbols it uses (and the `logic.py` mastery helpers) so callers + tests still resolve them as `bot.*`. Tests in `tests/`.
- **Hosting**: runs locally from a terminal — `python bot.py` on macOS/Linux, `./run.ps1` on Windows (PowerShell launcher: venv + deps + Ollama health check). For an always-on Windows box, `scripts/install-service.ps1` registers an NSSM service (`GoldenPagoda`) and `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` auto-deploys pushes to `main` via a **self-hosted Windows runner** (tests gate the deploy; the runner pulls `origin/main` into `GP_BOT_DIR` and restarts the service). An optional generic `Dockerfile` (`golden-pagoda:latest`) remains for container runs.
- **Modal-only flow**: members never post screenshots in a channel. Onboarding + `/profile` + `/manage` collect a screenshot through a **modal**; there is no passive channel scan and no catch-up. Verification OCRs the screenshot, assigns roles, and writes the member's record. Role changes are tracked (`on_member_update`) to keep the record in sync.

## Running locally

- **macOS/Linux**: `pip install -r requirements.txt && cp .env.example .env`, fill `DISCORD_TOKEN` + `TARGET_CHANNEL_ID`, then `python bot.py`.
- **Windows**: `./run.ps1` (creates `.venv`, installs deps, copies `.env.example`→`.env` on first run, pings the local Ollama server when `OLLAMA_OCR_MODEL` is set, then runs `bot.py`). `-NoInstall` skips the install step.
- **Local OCR**: `ollama pull llama3.2-vision && ollama serve`, set `OLLAMA_OCR_MODEL=llama3.2-vision` in `.env`. Fully offline; falls back to OCR.space then Tesseract on failure.
- **`.env`**: lives in the repo root (gitignored), the single source of truth. Edit it directly and restart the bot. Runtime state (analytics DB, records index, health signal) lives under `./data/`.
- **Logs**: printed to the terminal running the bot.

## Configuration (`.env`)

- `DISCORD_TOKEN`, `TARGET_CHANNEL_ID` — required.
- `OLLAMA_OCR_MODEL` — local Ollama vision model (e.g. `llama3.2-vision`); when set, OCR runs fully offline via Ollama. `OLLAMA_URL` (default `http://localhost:11434`), `OLLAMA_TIMEOUT` (default `120`).
- `OCR_API_KEY` — OCR.space key (engine 3), used as a fallback; falls back further to local Tesseract if empty.
- `PLATFORM_ROLE_<PC|XBOX|PLAYSTATION|SWITCH|MOBILE>_ID` — auto-resolved from role name on connect, written back.
- `CLAN_ROLE_{1..7}_NAME/_ID/_EMOJI` — 7 clan slots; names auto-resolve to IDs on connect.
- `PLATFORM_EMOJI_<PC|XBOX|PLAYSTATION|SWITCH|MOBILE>` — custom Discord emojis (`<:name:id>` format).
- `SYNDICATE_EMOJI` — custom Discord emoji (`<:name:id>`) for the Syndicate row on the `/profile` card; empty default (falls back to a bullet). Set it in `.env`.
- `SYNDICATE_EMOJI_<KEY>` — per-faction custom emoji (`<:name:id>`) for the `/profile` syndicate band, one per canonical Warframe syndicate (`STEEL_MERIDIAN`, `ARBITERS_OF_HEXIS`, `CEPHALON_SUDA`, `THE_PERRIN_SEQUENCE`, `RED_VEIL`, `NEW_LOKA`). Blank falls back to `SYNDICATE_EMOJI` then a bullet. Faction name colours are hardcoded in `_SYNDICATE_FACTIONS` / `_syndicate_style` (bot.py). Set it in `.env`.
- `INCOMPLETE_ROLE_ID`, `VERIFY_REMOVE_ROLE_ID` — verification flow roles.
- `REPLY_TTL_SECONDS` — auto-delete bot replies after N seconds.
- `HEALTH_PATH` (default `./data/gp_health`), `HEALTH_INTERVAL` (default `20` seconds) — liveness signal.
- `ANALYTICS_DB_PATH` (default `./data/analytics.db`) — SQLite path for analytics, member titles, and onboarding state.
- `RECORDS_INDEX_PATH` (default `./data/records_index.json`) — JSON `user_id → [record message_ids]` index for fast member-record lookups in the records channel.
- `ONBOARDING_CHANNEL_ID` (default `TARGET_CHANNEL_ID`) — channel where the join-welcome prompt is posted. Set it in `.env`.
- `MEMBER_RECORDS_CHANNEL_ID` (default `0`, disabled) — the records ("profile-log") channel: the source of truth for member profile data. Each member's record (their uploaded screenshot + parsed profile) is posted/edited here. May be a thread ID. Set to `0` to disable. Set it directly in the local `.env`.
- `ONBOARDING_REPROMPT_HOURS` (default `5`) — hours before re-posting the welcome prompt if the member hasn't completed onboarding. Set it in `.env`.
- `ONBOARDING_MAX_REPROMPTS` (default `3`) — maximum number of re-prompts per member before stopping. Set it in `.env`.
- `ONBOARDING_MAX_OCR_FAILS` (default `3`) — consecutive OCR failures before routing a member to manual review. Set it in `.env`.
- `ONBOARDING_POLL_SECONDS` (default `600`) — polling interval (seconds) for the reprompt sweep background task. Set it in `.env`.
- Never commit `.env`. Edit it locally, then restart the bot.

## Slash Commands

- `/clan-emblems role:<role> emoji:<:name:id>` — set per-clan emoji at runtime. Updates in-memory `CLAN_SLOTS`, `os.environ`, AND rewrites the local `.env`. Requires Manage Server perm.
- `/status` — single ephemeral V2 paginated message with 6 pages (bot, roles, channels, ocr, stats, clans). Prev/Next/Refresh buttons walk every page. Requires Manage Server perm. The "Bot" page surfaces `healthy`/`unhealthy` based on the health signal age (>90s = stale).
- `/profile [user] [ephemeral] [edit_mastery]` — render a member's **user profile** card PNG: the same role-derived reference grid as the verification progress card (Clan | Platform over Mastery Rank | Syndicate) but **without the progress bar**, under a refined gold "USER PROFILE" eyebrow + name header. Open to everyone and **anyone may target any member** via `user:` (defaults to the caller). **ephemeral defaults to true**; `ephemeral:false` (post publicly) is gated to managers / `PROFILE_OPTIONS_ROLE_IDS` — everyone else's reply stays ephemeral. On each use it refreshes the member's record from their live clan/platform roles via `_edit_or_create_member_record` (which reads the existing record first and preserves the OCR-only in-game name + exact mastery, so a role-driven refresh never wipes them). `edit_mastery:true` (opt-in, only on your own profile) attaches a Mastery Rank dropdown (1-30 / Legendary 1-8) that swaps your coarse MR role bucket AND writes the exact rank into your record — no one can change another member's MR.
- `/titles [action] [member] [title] [reason]` — admin command (Manage Server perm) to grant or remove a member's **cosmetic profile title**. All args optional: run without (or with partial) args it opens `_TitlesModal` — an interactive form (action select, member user-select, title, optional reason) pre-filled with whatever was passed; the `/manage` Edit page's Titles button opens the same modal with the member pre-bound (no member select). `add` upserts via `analytics.award_title` (the optional `reason` shows in the ephemeral confirm); `remove` deletes via `analytics.revoke_title` (case-insensitive match). Both paths share `_apply_title_change`. No pings; ephemeral confirm.
- `/manage member:<member>` — admin command (Manage Server perm) **manual backup** for the autonomous on-leave data clear, plus an admin **screenshot update**. A single ephemeral V2 paginated panel styled exactly like `/status` (3 pages: Overview / Titles / Data & Clear; Prev/Next/Refresh nav via `_manage_nav_row`). Lets a moderator inspect a member's profile (read from the records channel) + titles and, on the Data page, **clear** them behind a confirm step (danger button → `ACCENT_FAIL` confirm panel → `manage:<id>:clearok` runs `analytics.delete_member_data`). The **Overview** page also carries an **"Update from screenshot"** button (`manage:<id>:update`, shown only while the member is still in the guild) that opens `_ManageScreenshotModal` — an admin-facing sibling of the `/profile` "Verify Profile Data" modal. On submit it OCRs the uploaded profile screenshot through the same `_verify_member_from_screenshot` pipeline (writes in-game name / clan / mastery into the member's record + assigns roles for the **target** member), then refreshes the Overview page in place via `_interaction_edit_original_v2` (a raw-HTTP `PATCH …/messages/@original` that re-sends the V2 component tree, since discord.py 2.x can't edit raw V2 dicts) and posts an ephemeral summary. Param is `discord.User` (NOT Member) so it also works for members who already left. Built by `_manage_components` / `_manage_snapshot`; buttons dispatched by `_handle_manage_interaction` (re-checks `manage_guild` per click — the modal re-checks again in `on_submit`) off the `manage:` `custom_id` branch in `on_interaction`. The clear path never touches roles; the screenshot-update path is the only one that assigns them. Separate from the autonomous clear (`on_member_remove`).
- Sync happens in `on_ready` via `tree.sync()` — currently 5 top-level commands (`/clan-emblems`, `/status`, `/profile`, `/titles`, `/manage`), none are groups.
- **Profile card** (`_render_profile_card_png` in `cards.py`): a supersampled rounded slate card on the shared `_card_backdrop` (gold focal glow + energy-cyan bloom + framing vignette) with a circular avatar. The header stacks a gold "USER PROFILE" eyebrow, the member name, and the **platform icon** (icon-only, left-aligned under the name with a soft gold glow) on the left of the avatar, separated by a thin gold accent rule; the **Clan** field is a callout on the **right of the header** (a gold `CLAN` eyebrow over the clan emoji + name) aligned to the same two rows, budgeted/ellipsized to ~45% so it can't crowd the member name, with the clan **name** in the **clan role's own colour** (`role.color.to_rgb()`, plumbed through `_member_profile_info_lines` as a 4th Clan-row element; gold fallback). Purely role-derived (no OCR). Beneath the header the **Mastery Rank** sits in a **gold capsule badge** (`Mastery Rank: <value>`, gold-tinted fill + hairline gold border), and any **Syndicates** render as **faction-coloured** rows: icon + coloured name for one or two, collapsing to an **icon-only** row when three or more. Faction colour + per-faction emoji come from `_syndicate_style` (canonical Warframe palette + `SYNDICATE_EMOJI_<KEY>`, e.g. `SYNDICATE_EMOJI_RED_VEIL`; unknown names fall back to the role colour + shared `SYNDICATE_EMOJI`). Categories the member hasn't earned render an em-dash "—" (the syndicate band is simply omitted when none). Rows come from the async `_member_profile_info_lines(member)` gatherer (Clan slot name + emoji + role colour, platform + `PLATFORM_EMOJI_*`, mastery role name + `MASTERY_RANK_EMOJI`, and Syndicate as a per-faction `(name, accent_rgb, emoji_bytes)` list); the Mastery Rank row prefers the **exact stored rank** from the member's record over the coarse role bucket, formatted through the shared `_format_mastery_display` (`"MR 28"`→`"28"`, `"LR 3"`→`"Legendary 3"`). `/profile` defers then sends just the `profile.png` image (no V2 container) — unless `edit_mastery:true`, which also attaches a native `_MasteryEditorView` (`discord.ui.View` + two `_MasterySelect`s, split because Discord caps a select at 25 options; `interaction_check` restricts it to the profile owner; each select stashes its editor back-ref as `self._editor` — NOT `_parent`, which discord.py reserves for `Item._run_checks`). A pick runs `_apply_mastery_bucket` (`_mr_bucket_role_for` maps the rank to the configured bucket by parsing live role names via `_parse_mr_bucket_range`, robust to non-index-aligned `MR_ROLE_IDS`), then `await`s `_edit_or_create_member_record(..., mastery_rank=…)` synchronously (writing the exact rank into the member's record, the source of truth) to avoid a re-render race, then edits the message in place with the fresh card.
- **Records channel = profile source of truth** (`records_index.py` + `bot.py`): there is **no durable profile cache**. Each member has a canonical **record message** in `MEMBER_RECORDS_CHANNEL_ID` holding their uploaded screenshot + a parsed profile (`Key: **Value**` lines for in-game name / clan / platform / mastery rank / syndicate). `records_index.py` (stdlib JSON at `RECORDS_INDEX_PATH`) maps `user_id → [record message_ids]` (newest appended last, so use `ids[-1]`); `add_record`, `get_record_message_ids`, `get_channel_id`, `load_index`. Reads go through `_member_profile_from_records(guild_id, user_id)` — a **60s TTL** in-memory wrapper (`_RECORD_PROFILE_TTL_SECONDS`, `_record_profile_cache`) around `_read_member_profile_from_records`, which raw-HTTP-GETs the latest record message (`_fetch_record_message`), walks its V2 type-10 text (`_collect_v2_text`), and parses it (`_parse_record_profile_text` via `_RECORD_LINE_RE`; mastery is only kept when it's an exact `MR n` / `LR n` rank with `n ≥ 1` via `_is_exact_mastery_rank` — a bogus `MR 0` is rejected so a stray OCR digit can't stick in the record and override the real rank role). `_invalidate_record_profile_cache` clears an entry after a write. Writes go through `_edit_or_create_member_record(member, *, in_game_name=None, mastery_rank=None, extra_lines=None, image_bytes=None)`: it **edits the existing record in place** (`ids[-1]`) when one exists, else **creates one only when it carries evidence** — the member's uploaded screenshot (`image_bytes`) or an explicit manual-review note (`extra_lines`). A **purely role-derived refresh** (verified-role grant via `_finalize_onboarding_with_record`, mastery/IGN editor, `on_member_update` role change) that finds **no existing record never mints a brand-new, screenshot-less "Member Record" log** — that empty profile log is the missing-screenshot bug this guard prevents; the member gets a real record when they actually upload a screenshot (onboarding verify / `/profile` verify / `/manage` screenshot). When a caller omits `in_game_name`/`mastery_rank` it **reads the existing record first and preserves those OCR-only fields** so a role-driven refresh never clobbers the exact mastery / in-game name. Role-derived fields (clan, platform, coarse mastery bucket, syndicate) are rebuilt from live roles each write via `_member_record_profile_lines`. All record I/O is fail-soft.
- **Dynamic record sync via role tracking** (`on_member_update` in bot.py, `intents.members = True`): when a member's roles change, the handler compares the **tracked** role-id set (`_tracked_role_ids()` — clan/platform/mastery/syndicate) before/after; if unchanged it returns. Otherwise, **only if the member already has a record** (`records_index.get_record_message_ids`), it schedules `_edit_or_create_member_record(after)` via `_spawn_bg_task` to refresh the record in place. A role edit alone **never creates** a record. Record edits use `_edit_channel_message_v2` (JSON PATCH including `flags: COMPONENTS_V2_FLAG` + `attachments: [{"id": existing_id}]` to retain the screenshot) or `_edit_message_v2_with_file` (multipart, when a new image is supplied).
- **On-leave data clear** (privacy policy): when a member leaves/is kicked/is banned, `on_member_remove` (bot.py) schedules `_clear_member_data_on_leave(guild_id, user_id, label)` via `_spawn_bg_task` — it `await asyncio.to_thread`s `analytics.delete_member_data(*, guild_id, user_id)`, which runs an **explicit transaction** (BEGIN/COMMIT, ROLLBACK on error — the conn is autocommit, so this is what makes the purge atomic) that `DELETE`s the member's `member_titles` + `onboarding_prompts` rows and **anonymises** their telemetry (`UPDATE events SET user_id=NULL` — rows kept for aggregate stats), returning a `{titles, events_anonymized, onboarding}` audit dict (logged at INFO when any rows change). Strictly scoped to the `(guild_id, user_id)` pair, fail-soft, off the event loop, and never raises (a gateway event can't crash the bot). The member's record message in the records channel is **not** auto-deleted by this path (a moderator removes it via `/manage` if desired); roles are not touched. `/manage` is the manual backup of this path.
- **Member titles** (`analytics.py`): a `member_titles` table (PK `(guild_id, user_id, title_key)` where `title_key` is the case-folded title; columns `title`, `reason`, `event_name`, `awarded_ts`; same fail-soft SQLite DB) holds the cosmetic achievement titles granted by `/titles`. `award_title(...)` upserts (`ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE`, idempotent per title — re-awarding refreshes reason/timestamp, no dup), `list_member_titles(guild_id, user_id)` returns them newest-first, `revoke_title(...)` deletes one. `_member_profile_info_lines` appends a `("Titles", [names…])` row (newest-first) which `_render_profile_card_png` draws as a gold **"TITLES" chip band** beneath the Mastery capsule — wrapped rounded chips in the mastery-capsule style, capped at `_PROFILE_MAX_TITLE_CHIPS` (6) visible with a trailing `+N` overflow chip; the `reason`/`event_name` live only in the DB, not on the card.
- **Member onboarding flow**: When a new member joins the server, `on_member_join` posts a **public** Components V2 welcome in `ONBOARDING_CHANNEL_ID` (default `TARGET_CHANNEL_ID`) that @-mentions the joining member and shows **dynamic clan buttons** (from live `CLAN_SLOTS`, with names + per-clan emoji, split ≤5 per row) plus a **"Not listed / No"** button. All buttons have `custom_id` format `onboard:<user_id>:clan:<slot_no>` or `onboard:<user_id>:none`, encoding the target member's ID so buttons survive bot restarts/deploys. Clicking a clan button opens `_OnboardingVerifyModal` (a subclass of `discord.ui.Modal`) which accepts a Warframe profile screenshot; the screenshot is OCR'd via `_verify_member_from_screenshot` and the clan the member *claimed* (button slot) must be confirmed by checking that `_verify_member_from_screenshot` actually assigned the claimed clan's role (`member.get_role(claimed.role_id)`). Consecutive OCR/mismatch failures are tracked in `onboarding_prompts.ocr_fail_count`; at `ONBOARDING_MAX_OCR_FAILS` the member is routed to manual review. Clicking "Not listed / No" assigns `INCOMPLETE_ROLE_ID`, notifies `HELP_CHANNEL_ID`, and acknowledges ephemerally. On success, `_edit_or_create_member_record` writes the member's canonical record to `MEMBER_RECORDS_CHANNEL_ID` (creating it on first onboarding) — the member's **uploaded profile screenshot** (the bytes from the modal, threaded through as `image_bytes`) plus a V2 heading + media gallery + gold container of parsed profile lines (via `_post_channel_v2_with_file`); if no image is available the record is posted text-only. Onboarding state (prompt message ID, posted timestamp, completion status, reprompt count, OCR fail count) is persisted in the `onboarding_prompts` SQLite table (`analytics.py`). If the member has not completed onboarding after `ONBOARDING_REPROMPT_HOURS` hours, `_onboarding_reprompt_sweep` deletes the old welcome message and posts a fresh one in `ONBOARDING_CHANNEL_ID`; this stops after `ONBOARDING_MAX_REPROMPTS` re-posts. The reprompt loop (`_onboarding_reprompt_task`) polls every `ONBOARDING_POLL_SECONDS` seconds; an immediate sweep runs on startup to handle prompts whose window elapsed while the bot was offline. Every interaction handler checks `interaction.user.id == target_uid_from_custom_id` and rejects any other user with an ephemeral notice.

## Code Conventions

- No formatter/linter enforced — match surrounding style. Pre-existing E501 line-length warnings are ignored.
- Type hints used (`from __future__ import annotations`). `dict[str, X]` style (3.9+).
- Logging via `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`, level INFO.
- Components V2 messages sent via raw HTTP (`_send_v2`, `_interaction_callback` in `bot.py`) — discord.py 2.x has no native v2 support. Flags: `COMPONENTS_V2_FLAG = 1<<15`, `EPHEMERAL_FLAG = 64`. Callback types: 4 initial, 6 deferred-update, 7 update-message.
- Don't add docstrings/comments/type annotations to code you didn't change.
- Tests use `pytest`. Run with `DISCORD_TOKEN=test TARGET_CHANNEL_ID=1 python -m pytest tests/ -q` (199 tests).
- `.env` writers (`_update_env_clan_slots`, `_update_env_platform_ids`, `_update_env_id_list`) share one `_rewrite_env_file(replace_line, missing_lines)` skeleton — add new persisters through it rather than re-implementing the read→replace→append loop. CDN fetches (avatar + emoji) share `_fetch_cdn_bytes`.
- **Memory budget**: route heavy image work (card renders + OCR) through `await _run_heavy(func, ...)` (bounded by `_HEAVY_JOB_SEMAPHORE = asyncio.Semaphore(2)`), NOT bare `asyncio.to_thread`. Never run SQLite on the event loop — use `asyncio.to_thread` / `_spawn_bg_task`. Card text is budgeted via the shared `_ellipsize(draw, text, font, max_w)` helper. `_fetch_emoji_bytes` only caches successful fetches (a transient CDN `None` must not be cached). Deferred commands report errors via `interaction.followup.send` (a plain `response.send_message` is a no-op once deferred).

## Repository

- Origin: `https://github.com/aidenlong04/Golden-Pagoda-Image-Reader.git` (only `main`).
- Workspace folder name (`Golden-Pagoda-Screenshot-verify`) differs from repo name — that's expected.

## Things NOT in scope

- The bot runs on the user's own hardware — don't suggest Fly.io, Heroku, Hetzner, or other **cloud** hosting. The only supported deploy is the optional **self-hosted Windows runner** (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` + `scripts/install-service.ps1`) that pushes to the user's own device; the `GP_BOT_DIR` path is a runner machine env var, not a bot `.env` var.
- Don't add new env vars without updating both `.env.example` and the local `.env`.
- Don't commit secrets, SSH keys, or `.env`.
- Don't delete the `data/` or `icons/` folders — both hold local runtime state.
